title: Salty Dogs House | KEY.co
description_expanded: Step inside and immerse yourself in the true beach vibe that this home offers. The cottage surprises and delights with its comfortable decor and inviting atmosphere. The open floor plan on the first floor provides ample space to relax after a fun-filled day at the beach. Whether you choose to entertain guests on the rustic porch or inside, you'll appreciate the crisp and modern interior that seamlessly blends with the coastal surroundings. Located just steps away from the pristine white sand, this vacation home embodies the essence of a laid-back beach lifestyle. This delightful cottage welcomes you with its vibrant colors and relaxed ambiance, creating the perfect environment for guests to unwind and embrace the coastal atmosphere. Picture yourself swaying on the porch swing of the wraparound porch, enjoying the gentle Seaside breeze and letting time slip away. As if the cottage itself wasn't enticing enough, it boasts a prime location just 72 steps away from the beach. Additionally, it is conveniently situated only one block away from the best attractions and destinations that Seaside has to offer. With its unbeatable combination of comfort, style, and proximity to the beach, it's no wonder that this home easily stands out as the top choice for any vacation getaway.
